The Score-Driven Recursion's Fifth Derivative

Source: R/gas_fifth.R
term_fifth.GasTerm.Rd

Computes the fifth derivative of the filtered predictor in the caller's unknowns, contracted against the caller's weights and three directions, together with the lower orders' contractions along the same directions.

Arguments

score_values

NULL, or the driving score at every observation, read instead of evaluating score.

Value

As term_fifth().

Details

The jets of the level, of the score and of the chart are carried along every subset of the three directions, and each product of the recursion is differentiated by the product rule over those subsets. The chart's derivatives come from .gas_chart_contract() and gas_levinson5(), the score's from the family's arrays by .gas_score_jet().

The compiled kernel (.gas_fifth_compiled()) is the route; the R functions .gas_fifth_scalar() and .gas_fifth_sub() are an independent computation kept for the tests.
